description:
Build a multi-layer world reference map in gvSIG Desktop. You need to create a view and add three Natural Earth shapefiles as layers in the correct draw order.

The three shapefiles to add are:
1. Countries (polygons): /home/ga/gvsig_data/countries/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.shp
2. Rivers (lines): /home/ga/gvsig_data/rivers/ne_110m_rivers_lake_centerlines.shp
3. Populated Places / Cities (points): /home/ga/gvsig_data/cities/ne_110m_populated_places.shp

Requirements:
- All three layers must be added to a single View
- Layer draw order must be correct: countries (polygons) on the BOTTOM, rivers (lines) in the MIDDLE, and cities/populated places (points) on TOP. In the Table of Contents, the bottom-most layer is drawn first. Make sure polygons don't cover the lines and points.
- All three layers must be visible (checked on in the Table of Contents)
- Save the project as: /home/ga/gvsig_data/projects/reference_map.gvsproj

gvSIG is already open showing the Project Manager. Use the Project Manager to create/open a View, then use View > Add Layer (or the Add Layer toolbar button) to load each shapefile. Drag layers in the Table of Contents to reorder them if needed.
